admission.justification: Reporting branch movement when the re-read tip is unchanged would conceal a real Git hook or lock refusal. Re-reading the intended ref distinguishes an actual concurrent tip change from a failed update at the admitted tip and preserves Git's diagnostic in the latter case.

applicability: A failed ref update during publication or take-back.
conditions: The intended ref was re-read after the failure.
exclusions: A rejection with no moved tip; Git's own text is kept.
statement: A failed ref update reports a moved branch only if its tip moved and otherwise preserves Git refusal text.
